v.en: O God, come to my assistance;

r.en: O Lord, make haste to help me.

source.scope: Psalmi & antiphonæ ex Proprio de Tempore

text.la: Dóminus Deus * auxiliátor meus: et ídeo non sum confúsus.
text.en: The Lord God will help me * and therefore I am not confounded.

text.la: Circumdántes * circumdedérunt me: et in nómine Dómini vindicábor in eis.
text.en: They compassed me about, * yea, they compassed me about but in the Name of the Lord! I will destroy them.

text.la: Iúdica causam meam: * defénde, quia potens es, Dómine.
text.en: Judge Thou my cause, * and redeem me, O Lord, for Thou art mighty to save.

text.la: Cum Angelis * et púeris fidéles inveniámur, triumphatóri mortis clamántes: Hosánna in excélsis.
text.en: Fare we with Angels and men in faith to meet the Redeemer, * hailing the Slayer of death with joyful shouts of “Hosanna in the highest!”

text.la: Confundántur * qui me persequúntur, et non confúndar ego, Dómine, Deus meus.
text.en: Let them be confounded that persecute me; * but let not me be confounded, O Lord my God.

text.la: Fratres: Hoc enim sentíte in vobis, quod et in Christo Iesu: qui, cum in forma Dei esset, non rapínam arbitrátus est esse se æquálem Deo: sed semetípsum exinanívit, formam servi accípiens, in similitúdinem hóminum factus, et hábitu invéntus ut homo.
text.en: Brothers: For let this mind be in you, which was also in Christ Jesus: Who being in the form of God, thought it not robbery to be equal with God: But emptied himself, taking the form of a servant, being made in the likeness of men, and in habit found as a man.

v.la: Éripe me de inimícis meis, Deus meus.
v.en: Deliver me from my enemies, O my God.

r.la: Et ab insurgéntibus in me líbera me.
r.en: And defend me from them that rise up against me.

text.la: Turba multa, * quæ convénerat ad diem festum, clamábat Dómino: Benedíctus qui venit in nómine Dómini: Hosánna in excélsis.
text.en: Much people that were come to the Feast, cried * unto the Lord: Blessed is He That cometh in the Name of the Lord! Hosanna in the highest!

text.la: Omnípotens sempitérne Deus, qui humáno géneri, ad imitándum humilitátis exémplum, Salvatórem nostrum carnem súmere, et crucem subíre fecísti: concéde propítius; ut et patiéntiæ ipsíus habére documénta, et resurrectiónis consórtia mereámur.
text.en: Almighty and everlasting God, Who, of thy tender love towards mankind, hast sent thy Son our Saviour Jesus Christ to take upon Him our flesh and to suffer death upon the Cross, that all mankind should follow the example of His great humility; mercifully grant, that we may both follow the example of His patience, and also be made partakers of His resurrection.

office.title: Dominica II Passionis seu in Palmis
